title: The agent-spawn guard counts a marker on any line of a brief, so a pasted template block lifts a builder to Opus and falsely refuses a haiku reviewer
why: A lane pasting the template's "Agent spawn brief head" block whole changes the model it gets, and a haiku reviewer is refused for a marker it did not mean.
source: Coordinator 17:04 CST Nov 13, from lane brief-from-step (session_013NEJL3zemFrPdTzdnwhpVi; PRs #3261, #3262); the lane's measures, unchecked by the coordinator and by triage.
